chansons.style: Smooth jazz lounge, brushed drums, upright bass, warm saxophone, soulful male vocal, 85 BPM, nostalgic and intimate mood
chansons.resume_fr: Un homme se remémore ses souvenirs d'enfance dans les rues de sa ville natale.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Soft brushed snare, upright bass walking)

[Verse 1]
The streetlights flicker on the avenue
Where I spent my childhood running through
The corner store is painted something new
But the shadows still remember me and you
I hear the distant whistle of the train
Echoing across the cobblestone and rain
Every alleyway whispers my old name
Nothing in this world will feel the same

[Pre-Chorus]
I close my eyes and breathe the evening air
The ghosts of yesterday are everywhere

[Chorus]
Oh, hometown, you hold my heart in stone
Every cracked pavement leads me back to home
In the velvet night, beneath the amber glow
You're the only true north I will ever know

[Verse 2]
The old oak tree is standing by the square
I used to carve my secrets in it there
The jazz club on the corner plays a tune
That pulls me back beneath the silver moon
I see the faces of the friends I lost
We didn't know the heavy price of cost
But in this quiet lounge, the glasses clink
And I am pulled right to the river's brink

[Pre-Chorus]
I close my eyes and breathe the evening air
The ghosts of yesterday are everywhere

[Chorus]
Oh, hometown, you hold my heart in stone
Every cracked pavement leads me back to home
In the velvet night, beneath the amber glow
You're the only true north I will ever know

[Bridge]
Miles away I tried to run and hide
But the rhythm of your streets is deep inside
A saxophone is crying through the dark
Reminding me of where I left my spark

[Saxophone Solo]

[Chorus]
Oh, hometown, you hold my heart in stone
Every cracked pavement leads me back to home
In the velvet night, beneath the amber glow
You're the only true north I will ever know

[Outro]
True north...
Bring me home...
(Fade out with brushed drums)

[Chorus]
Premier amour, ombre sur le trottoir
Tu es le secret de mon histoire
Dans ce lounge feutré, je te revois

Mon premier amour...

[Trumpet Solo]

Exile is a shadow on the wall
Homesickness is answering the call
